title: Retry 20261027-233442-hyv6: drain fix request and verified reopened
summary: Retry of job 20261027-233442-hyv6: keep its drain fix-request work (steward.rs, drain.rs, pin.rs, tests/drain.rs, CHANGELOG.md), fix its findings, and make the reopened-returns-to-Queued citation (c45) checked. The study's model, intro lead-in and glossary already say reopened returns the item to Queued, so those are verified, not rewritten.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check that the source check passes and the duplicate request is not repeated.
Drain test criterion checks queuing behavior.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Prior job 20261027-233442-hyv6 addressed. (a) Major c45 finding: re-cite c45 in claims.json from bin/fm-teardown.sh where the reopen path sets the row to Queued, read from the pinned source (via the study's source-reading tooling), and confirm the study validates with the pinned source, not 'conventions only'. If the pinned source is absent in this copy, the quote must be one that the checker can match, and the CHANGELOG must say what was not checked. (b) Minor duplicate-key finding: tighten the steward.rs finding marker to include the claim id or cited source path and lines, not only file and kind, so a new contradiction in the same file is queued while the same one is skipped. (c) Minor doc-comment finding: move the study_text doc comment back directly above study_text in drain.rs. (d) Minor scope finding: pin.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs are kept and listed as deliverables.

Part 1 of the original request is already in the base: model.json t9 goes ready -> reopened with t12 reopened -> queued, and the intro.json glossary says the item goes back to Queued. The producer should only change model.json or intro.json if Grep for 'final state' or terminal-success finds a leftover; the lead-in in intro.json line 54 should be checked for 'Done and Reopened both end the task'.

Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (study_text at ~3496, source check and report handling), crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (StewardRequest builder, source_fix_request, finding_marker, citing_request) and crates/athena-core/src/pin.rs (SourceReport, SourceProblem). The new studies/ files are not records under crates/, so no check_record_file or AnyRecord change is needed.
Goal: the drain source check stops repeating the same contradiction. Audience: the maintainer who reads drain reports and the verifier who runs cargo.
Environment: none beyond the local repository; no CI workflow, push or history read.

acceptance_criteria.text: claims.json claim c45 cites bin/fm-teardown.sh lines where the reopen path returns the row to Queued, with a quote that is present in those lines; git diff shows the lines changed from 3894-3896 or the CHANGELOG states the check result.
Grep for 'final state' and 'both end the task' in studies/firstmate-work-handling finds no claim that reopened is terminal; model.json shows reopened -> queued.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`: it builds the study without error and the drain source check passes on the corrected study.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo test -p athena-core`: the drain test with a fake source check reporting a contradiction shows exactly one fix request queued through StewardRequest citing the statement and source, none on a second run while it is open, and a different contradiction in the same file is still queued.
drain.rs has the study_text doc comment directly above `pub fn study_text`, checked with git diff.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry covering the study correction, the c45 citation and the drain fix-request queueing.

out_of_scope: Changing the source check model call itself
departures: The c45 citation depends on a pinned source that may be absent from the snapshot, so cost and the chance of rejection are somewhat worse than the reference.
urgent_reason: Stops the same study contradiction being reported on every drain, which wastes repeated drain attention.
hard_reason: Changes how drain queues fix requests after a failed source check, a rule that holds or skips work through duplicate detection in the run pipeline.
